200.title: Polish far-right lawmaker Braun charged over hospital ‘citizen’s arrest’
200.summary: News Politics Polish far-right lawmaker Braun charged over hospital ‘citizen’s arrest’ Grzegorz Braun faces up to five years in prison for allegedly detaining a doctor who had performed an abortion.
200.body: News Politics Polish far-right lawmaker Braun charged over hospital ‘citizen’s arrest’ Grzegorz Braun faces up to five years in prison for allegedly detaining a doctor who had performed an abortion. 20, 2026. | Sergei Gapon/AFP via Getty Images November 17, 2026 3:10 pm CET By Thibault Krause Polish prosecutors charged far-right European Parliament lawmaker Grzegorz Braun on Tuesday over an alleged incident in which he tried to carry out a “citizen’s arrest” of a doctor who had performed an abortion. Braun and several supporters entered the Oleśnica hospital in April 2025 to confront a gynecologist who had carried out a late-term abortion on a patient whose life was at risk. Braun, who leads the ultranationalist Confederation of the Polish Crown party, came fourth in Poland’s 2025 presidential election.

200.title: CEF Energy backs United Heat as Germany and Poland build a cross-border renewable heating system
200.summary: This includes studies on renewable heat generation, network routes, thermal storage and the cross-border pipeline, as well as a 25 MW biomass heating plant in Poland and a 1.43 km district heating pipeline in Görlitz linking Königshufen with the city’s wastewater treatment plant for waste heat recovery from a sewage-gas CHP plant.
200.body: EU funding is helping turn cross-border cooperation into a model for renewable district heating, as the German city of Görlitz and its Polish neighbour Zgorzelec advance the United Heat project. Supported by the Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) Energy , United Heat aims to replace fossil-fuel-based heating with an integrated district heating system powered entirely by renewable energy. This includes studies on renewable heat generation, network routes, thermal storage and the cross-border pipeline, as well as a 25 MW biomass heating plant in Poland and a 1.43 km district heating pipeline in Görlitz linking Königshufen with the city’s wastewater treatment plant for waste heat recovery from a sewage-gas CHP plant. A 100% renewable heating mix United Heat will combine biomass, heat pumps, solar thermal energy, power-to-heat and waste heat recovery.
